tokens.name: logo-gray-100
tokens.usage: Corporate/logo gray 100% (CMYK 10-5-5-80, RAL 7043, Pantone Neutral Black U). Primary logo color, default text color, corporate dark ground for slides, footers and brochure backs. White text on it: 7.9:1.

tokens.name: logo-gray-75
tokens.usage: Corporate/logo gray 75%. Tint for charts and large shapes. On white only 3.9:1, so text 24px+ or bold 19px+ only.

tokens.name: logo-gray-50
tokens.usage: Corporate/logo gray 50%. Alternative product-photo background; the inner rings of the primary blue logo. Not for text.

tokens.name: logo-gray-25
tokens.usage: Corporate/logo gray 25%. Light panels, table bands, hairlines. logo-gray-100 text on it: 5.5:1.

tokens.name: logo-blue
tokens.usage: Corporate/logo blue 100% (CMYK 100-70-33-20, RAL 5010, Pantone 295 U). Logo color and corporate color; base band under segment colors. White text on it: 10.2:1.

tokens.name: wind-100
tokens.usage: Segment color Wind 100% (CMYK 72-52-32-18, RAL 5023, Pantone 7693 U). Base color for Wind material. White text on it: 6.0:1.

tokens.name: wind-75
tokens.usage: Wind 75%. Tint for charts and shapes in Wind material. Not for body text on white.

tokens.name: wind-50
tokens.usage: Wind 50%. Tint for charts and shapes in Wind material. Not for text.

tokens.name: wind-25
tokens.usage: Wind 25%. Light panels in Wind material. The guide prints RGB 209-209-219 beside this hex; the hex is used.

tokens.name: building-100
tokens.usage: Segment color Building Materials 100% (CMYK 30-65-54-33, RAL 8002, Pantone 484 U). Base color for Building Materials. White text on it: 5.9:1.

tokens.name: building-75
tokens.usage: Building Materials 75%. Tint for charts and shapes. Not for body text on white.

tokens.name: building-50
tokens.usage: Building Materials 50%. Tint for charts and shapes. Not for text.

tokens.name: building-25
tokens.usage: Building Materials 25%. Light panels in Building Materials material.

tokens.name: industry-100
tokens.usage: Segment color Industry 100% (CMYK 70-40-45-27, RAL 7031, Pantone 3292 U). Base color for Industry material. White text on it: 5.7:1.

tokens.name: industry-75
tokens.usage: Industry 75%. Tint for charts and shapes. The guide prints RGB 122-145-147 beside this hex; the hex is used.

tokens.name: industry-50
tokens.usage: Industry 50%. Tint for charts and shapes. Not for text.

tokens.name: industry-25
tokens.usage: Industry 25%. Light panels in Industry material.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Secondary color Yellow ochre (CMYK 17-35-92-5, RAL 1012, Pantone 7550 U). Information design (graphs, charts), icons, and display headlines on dark grounds. As text: 4.3:1 on logo-blue, 3.4:1 on logo-gray-100, about 2.5:1 on segment colors, so display sizes only; the guide's own covers set it on building-100, a pair kept as the source shows it.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Secondary color Green mint (CMYK 65-0-40-0, RAL 6027, Pantone 3262 U). Information design (graphs, charts), icons, and display headlines on dark grounds. As text: 4.4:1 on logo-blue, 3.4:1 on logo-gray-100, about 2.5:1 on wind-100 and industry-100, so display sizes only; the guide's own covers use those pairs, kept as the source shows them.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Paper and page ground; the negative logo; text and icons on logo-gray-100, logo-blue and every 100% segment color.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Light: white paper. Dark: the corporate gray, the ground the guide gives the negative logo.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, table bands and cards set off from surface. The dark value is a darkened corporate gray, provisional (not in the guide).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default text on surface and surface-panel. Light: 7.9:1 on white, 5.5:1 on logo-gray-25. Dark: 7.9:1 on logo-gray-100, 9.7:1 on the dark panel.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text, icons and rings on the fixed brand fills logo-gray-100, logo-blue, wind-100, building-100 and industry-100 (5.7:1 or better). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px rules and borders on surface. Too faint to carry meaning on its own in either theme.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Digital only, not in the guide: the one interactive color for links, button fills and focus rings on surface. Light: logo blue (10.2:1 on white). Dark: white (7.9:1), because logo blue is only 1.3:1 on the corporate gray.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on an action fill. Light: white on logo blue (10.2:1). Dark: corporate gray on white (7.9:1).
